svg.title: Figure 4 Subgroups
svg.desc: Log-scale forest plot of mutually adjusted pooled and temporal factor odds ratios across all patients and predefined demographic, rate, conduction and care-setting subgroups. Estimates vary, with greater uncertainty in some groups; asterisks mark sparse or ill-conditioned fits. No interaction or independent-validation claim is made.

g.text: Mutually adjusted OR per training SD (pointwise 95% CI)
